svg.title: Session workflow management
svg.desc: This overview connects the four focused flows below. Their decisions and guard tables explain failure, waiting and recovery; a later box never supplies missing evidence for an earlier one.

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 1. User gives work to the lead

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 2. Lead finds or creates the Linear issue

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 3. Tool links the issue to this CLI session

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 5. Tool confirms worker and In Progress

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 7. Tool updates the CLI and notifies the lead

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 8. Lead processes and reports the outcome

g.data-value: The confirmed request, task, worker, delivery and reporting path.
g.text: The confirmed request, task, worker, delivery and reporting path.
